description: S45 T7 (PM9) behaviour 4: the per-caller cap on OPEN proposals (desk.MaxOpenProposalsPerAgent, 20) — a runaway loop must not bury the desk. The 21st file by a caller already holding twenty is a COUNTED refusal naming the limit and the way to see the queue (proposal_list); the 20th passed, this one writes nothing. The limit is a named constant beside the proposal validators, not a hidden number in a switch.

params.reason: the twenty-first in a row — the cap exists so a runaway loop cannot bury the desk

error.message: invalid params: refused: agent implementer already holds 20 open proposals — that is the per-agent cap; see them with proposal_list and ask a person to decide one before filing more
